summary: Every visible object in the Pump Lab is built from primitives in code. No mesh, texture, HDRI, audio, font or image file is downloaded, copied or generated by this package.

fonts.note: Text asks for KairoManrope or Manrope and falls back to Arial. The shell's bundled Manrope (SIL OFL, supplied with the font) applies when its stylesheet is loaded; this package adds no font file.
